During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]] headed a '''organization''' of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They attempted to raid an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but [[Fandar's right-hand man]] betrayed them and they were led into a trap.<ref name="Pirate" />
